name: Commodore Perry Hotel / Apartments (1927), Jefferson Ave at Superior St
refs: refs/w429963556/00 (Commodore Perry Hotel from south, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Renaissance-revival hotel tower in tan brick: a limestone base with storefronts, a long shaft of single and paired windows with terracotta sill bands, a top belt and deep bracketed cornice, two-storey penthouse block above.
